getInfo advertises a real, model-identifying AAGUID; the registration backs it with an x5c certificate from a manufacturer CA. Both need an attestation key that stays secret in a certified device, which exp175 showed this chip cannot keep. (Note: in a fido-u2f attestation the authData AAGUID field is zeroed by spec, so the certificate, not that field, is the real discriminator.)
